description: Make the Aero Hand its own design family in the live preview's top-level design dropdown, alongside Generalist Gripper, Glove Hand and Orca Hand, not a Base version. Move the left Aero Hand assembly out of the generalist Base line (Base 13, voice-c0e340c7, put it there). It must still attach directly to the reBot arm through the Mount part (Mount 1), selectable as the arm's end effector. Fix AGENTS.md so the Aero Hand is its own family with its own versions, and note Base 13 as an Aero Hand assembly, not a base change. Related: voice-a5d65841 (per-part picker; its worker was steered to treat Aero Hand as an end-effector part on the Mount and drop Base 13 as a Base option).

results.identified_issue: Family reassignment happens at the end of publish_designs.discover(), after the carried-part split, so ids (computed from the old 'Generalist Gripper' project) stay stable: 'generalist-gripper-aero-hand-1' and 'two-finger-gripper-v313-...'. Gallery: MIX generalized to MIXES [MIX, AERO_MIX]; AERO_MIX.parts limits pickers to arm/mount/aero; picks[] holds per-mix state (generalist keeps its arm/mount/aero default 'none'; aero mix defaults to newest). mixOptions reads parts from both projects. buildMix(which) nulls keys outside which.parts; first picker has no 'none' option. Rejected: moving Arm/Mount to their own family (they're shared interfaces used by both). Pre-existing failing test: test_gripper_poses v306 missing poses.js entry.
results.summary: Aero Hand is now its own family in the live preview dropdown, opening on Arm 1 + Mount 1 + Aero Hand 1; Base 13 is gone from the Generalist line
results.detailed_description: The live preview's top dropdown now has an Aero Hand family next to Generalist Gripper, Glove Hand and Orca Hand. It opens on a new mix tile with three pickers: Arm, Mount and Aero Hand. By default that shows Arm 1 + Mount 1 + Aero Hand 1, with the hand sitting on the Mount's hub on the arm. The screenshot shows it. The family's other two tiles are Aero Hand 1 (the hand by itself) and Aero Hand 1 assembly (the old v313 folder). The Generalist Gripper family no longer lists either one. The Generalist mix still offers Aero Hand as the arm's end effector, so ?base=none&arm=1&mount=1&aero=1 works as before. How it works: the publisher puts any folder whose VERSIONS.txt heading carries an Aero Hand, and the Aero Hand parts it splits out, under a new 'Aero Hand' project. Design ids don't change, so old links still open. Arm and Mount stay Generalist parts. The two mix tiles remember their picks separately. AGENTS.md now says the Aero Hand is its own family with its own version numbers, never a Base number, and that it attaches through the Mount. It also says v313 is the Aero Hand 1 assembly, not a base change. I added the same note to v313's VERSIONS.txt entry. I did not rename that folder or change the 'Base 13' wording in its heading, so the history stays as it was. Tests: the publisher tests pass, including new checks for the family and ids. One gallery test fails: v306 (direct drive) has no hinge entry in poses.js. That failure doesn't come from this change. I checked the new tile in headless Chrome using a test catalog. The live server will pick it up on its next publish.

summary: The Aero Hand is currently filed as Base 13 under the Generalist Gripper line, but it should be its own family in the live preview's top-level design dropdown. It must still attach to the reBot arm via Mount 1 as an end effector, with AGENTS.md updated to list its own versions and note Base 13 as an Aero Hand assembly.
